question.text: A PMS equity portfolio with Sharpe Ratio of 1.5 is:

answer.text: Good to excellent (>1 is typically good)

explanation.text: The Logic: Sharpe > 1 = good; > 1.5 is very good (sustained). The Trap: Sharpe of 0.5 average, < 0.5 poor. Cross-Exam Context: Topic 20. Manager's Pro-Tip: Match Sharpe to benchmark Sharpe — standalone numbers can mislead.
